### Do You Have a Divided Heart?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-18-2024.html
Passage: Judges 16:5-6
Points:
- Samson's extraordinary power was supernatural through the Holy Spirit rather than natural physical physique.
- Despite having the Spirit upon him, Samson compromised by continually yielding to fleshly appetites.
- A believer cannot successfully sustain a double life of seeking God's power while indulging selfish desires.
- Compromise and divided devotion inevitably undermine spiritual strength and lead to destruction.

### The Secret Strength of Faith
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-8-2011.html
Passage: Judges 16:6
Points:
- Delilah's question regarding Samson's strength prompts an inquiry into where true spiritual strength lies.
- The vital power of faith comes from continually feeding upon God's gracious promises.
- Faith draws confidence from God's immutable character, omnipotence, and concern for His own glory.
- The sacrificial gift of Christ and memories of past deliverance assure believers of God's unchanging faithfulness.
